name: @nx9/desktop
description: NX9 Studio — Electron 桌面壳（打包 Web + NestJS 为 Windows .exe）

scripts.pack: set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:dir: set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win --dir
